timedMC.title: Beat the clock
timedMC.subtitle: 15 seconds per question. British English. Ask yourself: is the person back (been) or still away (gone)?

questions.text: I’ve        to Rome three times.
wrongReasons: Wrong word: ‘gone’ means the person is still away — here the person is back, or it is an experience.
Wrong tense: ‘went’ is the past simple — after ‘have/has’ you need a past participle (been or gone).
Wrong form: ‘was’ cannot follow ‘have/has’ — you need ‘been’ or ‘gone’.
questions.explain: ‘Three times’ counts finished visits to Rome — there and back: ‘been’.

Wrong form: ‘was’ cannot follow ‘have/has’ — you need ‘been’ or ‘gone’.
